_comment: This is the artefact that encodes 'questions and edits we've seen before'. In a real pilot this would be built by shadowing the legal team for a few days and writing down their standard positions, not guessed at by an engineer. Treat every value below as a placeholder to be replaced by the real legal team's actual fallback positions.

governing_law.escalate_if: Any governing law outside England & Wales / UK, especially US states or jurisdictions with materially different contract law norms.

confidentiality_term.standard_position: 3 years post-termination for mutual NDAs; indefinite only for trade secrets carve-out
confidentiality_term.escalate_if: Perpetual confidentiality with no trade-secret carve-out, or term exceeding 5 years.

limitation_of_liability.standard_position: Liability capped at 12 months' fees paid/payable under the agreement, with carve-outs for confidentiality breach, IP infringement, gross negligence, and death/personal injury.
limitation_of_liability.escalate_if: Liability uncapped, capped below 12 months' fees, or missing standard carve-outs.

indemnity.standard_position: Mutual indemnity, scoped to IP infringement and confidentiality breach only.
indemnity.escalate_if: One-sided/unilateral indemnity, or indemnity scope broader than IP + confidentiality (e.g. general 'any and all claims').

auto_renewal.standard_position: Auto-renewal permitted only with a minimum 30 days' written notice to opt out before renewal.
auto_renewal.escalate_if: Auto-renewal with no opt-out mechanism, or opt-out notice period longer than 60 days.

termination_for_convenience.standard_position: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice.
termination_for_convenience.escalate_if: No termination-for-convenience right, or notice period longer than 90 days.

ip_ownership.standard_position: Each party retains ownership of its own background IP; only newly created deliverables (if any) are assigned per statement of work.
ip_ownership.escalate_if: Broad assignment of background IP, or ambiguous ownership of pre-existing IP.

data_protection.standard_position: Must reference UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018 if any personal data is processed; standard mutual data processing clause required if personal data is shared.
data_protection.escalate_if: Personal data is in scope but no data protection clause is present, or clause references an incompatible/unclear regime.

payment_terms.escalate_if: Payment terms longer than Net 45, or unusual conditions precedent to payment.
